insights.title: High Frequency of Refresh Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 48 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of repeated refresh calls to optimize performance.

insights.title: UI Actions Correlate with API Calls
insights.description: User actions such as logging in and generating reports directly correlate with specific API calls, indicating a clear relationship.
insights.recommendation: Document the UI-API relationships for better understanding of user flows.

executiveSummary: • All tests executed successfully with no errors recorded.
• The most frequent API call was for refreshing budget controls, occurring 48 times in one test.
• User login and report generation workflows were clearly defined through API interactions.
• No significant latency issues were observed, with all p95 response times below 3 seconds.
• The high frequency of refresh calls may indicate inefficiencies in the workflow.
• Understanding the UI-API relationships can enhance user experience and system performance.
• Continuous monitoring of API performance is recommended to ensure optimal operation.
• Further analysis of the refresh call patterns could lead to performance improvements.
